Risk title: Sanctions or anti-corruption breach via an agent, supplier or acquired company
Cause: Operations in several jurisdictions; use of port agents, brokers and yards; acquired companies with weaker controls; sanctions lists change frequently.
Risk event: A counterparty, intermediary or acquired entity is involved in bribery or a sanctions breach attributable to Trident.
Consequences: Fines, debarment, bank and customer termination rights, personal liability, severe reputational damage and lower multiple.
Affected units: Commercial; Vessel Operations; Finance; Strategy & BD
Current mitigation: (1) Risk-based KYC and sanctions screening before first contract or payment (LEG 4.6); (2) enhanced DD and CEO approval for high-risk parties; (3) payment block for unapproved parties; (4) compliance DD and 100-day onboarding in acquisitions (LEG 4.5); (5) annual ABC training (LEG 4.10).
Evidence / rationale: Near-zero appetite for corruption and sanctions risk; impact rated catastrophic regardless of likelihood.

Risk title: New or changed regulation is detected or implemented too late
Cause: High regulatory change pace (flag state, Mattilsynet, IMO, CSRD/VSME, tax) across Norway, Chile and the UK; ownership of changes not always clear.
Risk event: A relevant regulatory change takes effect before the owning process has been updated.
Consequences: Non-compliance, operational stops or fines, rework costs and remarks from authorities or auditors.
Affected units: Vessel Operations; Technical & HSEQ; Finance; HR
Current mitigation: (1) Monthly monitoring of sources and change log with owner and deadline (LEG 4.2); (2) legal obligations register updated on every change (LEG 4.1); (3) quarterly executive report on overdue changes.
Evidence / rationale: Volume of regulatory change rising, particularly sustainability reporting and fish-welfare rules.

Risk title: Unfavourable contract terms on liability, indexation or termination
Cause: Commercial pressure in renewals and new tenders; non-standard customer and yard templates; time pressure before signing.
Risk event: Contracts are signed with uncapped liability, weak indexation or broad termination rights.
Consequences: Unprotected margin, exposure to large claims and weaker earnings visibility.
Current mitigation: (1) Trident standard terms and clause library; (2) legal review by risk level before signing; (3) approved deviations only per authority matrix (LEG 4.3); (4) term-playbook minimums in commercial mandates (SBD 4.5).
Evidence / rationale: Residual 12 – material; links to SBD-R103 (commercial terms erode).

Risk title: Contract signed without proper authority, or renewal and notice dates missed
Cause: Decentralised signing across entities and regions; no single contract register with key dates.
Risk event: A contract binds Trident without valid authority, or a renewal or termination window passes unnoticed.
Consequences: Unwanted commitments, lost renewal leverage or automatic extension on poor terms.
Current mitigation: (1) Authority matrix and signatory rights communicated to all departments (LEG 4.4); (2) contract register with key-date alerts to the CCO (LEG 4.3).
Evidence / rationale: Controls largely in place; register completeness to be verified.

Risk title: Hidden legal or compliance liabilities in an acquired company
Cause: Compressed deal timelines, limited data-room access and targets with weaker governance.
Risk event: Liabilities (disputes, permits, tax, employment, ESG) surface after closing.
Consequences: Unplanned costs, value leakage and integration delays.
Current mitigation: (1) Standard legal and compliance DD checklist (LEG 4.5); (2) warranties, indemnities and conditions in the SPA; (3) stop and escalation on deal-breakers; (4) W&I insurance where relevant.
Evidence / rationale: Trend increasing with the planned M&A programme; links to SBD-R005 and SBD-R110.

Risk title: Major dispute or claim, or insured loss not recovered
Cause: Incidents at sea or at yards, customer disputes on performance or off-hire, late notification to insurers.
Risk event: Trident faces a large claim or fails to recover an insured loss in full.
Consequences: Cash outflow, EBITDA volatility and management time.
Affected units: Vessel Operations; Technical & HSEQ; Commercial; Finance
Current mitigation: (1) Claims register and evidence preservation (LEG 4.9); (2) notification to P&I and H&M within policy deadlines; (3) CEO approval of settlement strategy; (4) lessons fed back to the owning process.
Evidence / rationale: Insurance programme in place; recovery performance to be tracked.

Risk title: Personal data breach involving crew, employees or customers
Cause: Increasing digitalisation, more systems and processors, phishing and cyber attacks.
Risk event: Personal data is lost, disclosed or processed unlawfully.
Consequences: Fines (up to 4 % of turnover), notification duties, loss of trust and remediation costs.
Current mitigation: (1) Record of processing, DPIAs and processor agreements (LEG 4.8); (2) breach procedure with 72-hour notification; (3) security requirements to Administration & ICT (3.3.12).
Evidence / rationale: Linked to cyber risk on the administrative platform (3.3.12).

Risk title: Misconduct is not reported, or reports are poorly handled
Cause: Low awareness of the whistleblowing channel, fear of retaliation, or lack of independent investigators.
Risk event: Serious misconduct continues unreported, or a report is handled in a way that breaks the law or trust.
Consequences: Legal breaches, retaliation claims, reputational damage and loss of key people.
Current mitigation: (1) Whistleblowing channel open to employees, crew and partners (LEG 4.7); (2) acknowledgement within 7 days and independent investigation; (3) Board decides where the CEO or a director is involved; (4) annual training (LEG 4.10).
Evidence / rationale: Channel in place; usage and awareness to be measured.

Risk title: Entity, board or filing deficiencies in Norway, Chile or the UK
Cause: Growing number of entities across jurisdictions; manual tracking of filings and board work.
Risk event: Filings, registrations or board resolutions are missing, late or invalid.
Consequences: Penalties, invalid decisions and findings in audits or due diligence by lenders and buyers.
Current mitigation: (1) Entity register with filing calendar (LEG 4.4); (2) quarterly governance review; (3) standard board-paper and minutes templates.
Evidence / rationale: Relevant for exit and refinancing readiness.

Risk title: Compliance awareness does not keep pace as Trident more than doubles in size
Cause: Rapid growth through acquisitions and new crews; different compliance cultures in acquired companies.
Risk event: New employees, crew and acquired companies are not trained or do not follow Trident's rules.
Consequences: Higher probability of breaches and weaker integration of acquired companies.
Current mitigation: (1) Risk-based annual training plan and onboarding for all new staff and crew (LEG 4.10); (2) annual declarations with 95 % completion target; (3) compliance onboarding of acquired companies within 100 days (LEG 4.5).
Evidence / rationale: Follows the growth ambition in the M&A plan (SBD 4.8).
